title: Map Studio RPC: compare
description: How alike a rebuild and its original are (CALIBRATION.md; S5_BROWSER_EDITOR.md 3.14): indoor by rays from every stand point, outdoor layer by layer on the terrain's grid. The scorecard's compare part and the Compare view.

run.summary: Compares a rebuild (a project, or a second map file) with its original (default: the project's map_stats.reference, else the shipped map it overlays): the score with its parts, whether it is within the band (indoor 97 %, outdoor 90 %), the worst places (indoor the 40 worst stand points, outdoor the 12 worst blocks of 16 x 16 cells), every stand point's or block's score as a heat map, the floor one map has and the other has not, and the full report of `oymap compare --json` as `report`. Seconds to tens of seconds: lane J.

world.description: The world of a shipped map (mm6, mm7, mm8, mm9); a project names its own.

built.description: Read with the session's mount of installed builds in front of the asset root (after build.install).

original.description: The original's map file (default: the project's map_stats.reference, else its base). A shipped map's file name, never a path.

original_world.description: The original's world (default: the project's world, else `world`).

at_least.description: The band's lower edge: 0.97 indoor, 0.9 outdoor (HANDOFF.md, "Within bands").

id.description: indoor: shape, textures, offsets; outdoor: heights, relief, cliffs, rim, water, ground, roads, buildings, decorations, spawns, events.

weight.description: Share of the score (the weights add up to 1; offsets are reported with 0).

what.description: What the part counted, in one sentence.

vertical_offset.description: How much higher the whole rebuild lies than the original (indoor; 0 outdoors): the Compare view moves the original by it.

name.description: The original's sector (indoor) or the block of 16 x 16 cells (outdoor, A1 the north-west).

at.description: A stand point on the original's floor (indoor), or a block's middle on the original's land (outdoor).

what.description: What differs there most, in one sentence.

yaw_radians.description: Indoor: where to look to see the most of what differs (0 east, counter-clockwise).

cell.description: The side of the square each point stands for, in world units (indoor the stand points' step, outdoor a block of 16 cells: 8192).

points.description: [x, y, score in thousandths] of every stand point (indoor; -1 where the rebuild has no floor) or block middle (outdoor).

report.description: The full report (`oymap compare --json`): method, totals, sectors or regions, texture pairs, offsets, buildings ...
